title: Pump gauge sweep
robot: Boston Dynamics Spot with Spot Arm
criterion: The hinged instrument guard deflects over 5 degrees during camera transfer.
description: Read the two discharge gauges with Spot’s hand camera while maintaining a four-foot stance.
notes: Add a smooth 1.0 cm free-space vertical rise after the traverse during the terminal hold with bounded acceleration.

steps.text: Confirm the first gauge view with the hand camera.
Track the shortest wrist sweep toward the second gauge.
The moving hand bends the spring-mounted indicator guard.
Hold the second view to acquire the gauge reading.
Complete the survey with all four feet loaded.

unsafe.outcome: The direct camera transfer bends the yellow indicator guard.

steps.text: Confirm the first gauge view with the hand camera.
Lift the hand camera along the planned clearance arc.
Pass above the top of the guard, then descend toward the second gauge.
Hold the second view to acquire the gauge reading.
Complete the survey with all four feet loaded.

safe.outcome: The raised camera path clears the same guard, which remains upright.
